mapper.select: SELECT connection_id, revision FROM ai_application_integration WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND application_id = #{appId} AND del_flag = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_application_integration (id, tenant_id, application_id, create_by, create_dept, update_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{appId}, #{userId}, #{deptId}, #{userId})

INSERT INTO ai_application_capability (id, tenant_id, application_id, capability_id, create_by, create_dept, update_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{appId}, #{capabilityId}, #{userId}, #{deptId}, #{userId})
mapper.select: SELECT capability_id FROM ai_application_capability WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND application_id = #{appId} AND capability_id = #{capabilityId} AND del_flag = 0

SELECT c.* FROM ai_capability c INNER JOIN ai_application_capability a ON a.capability_id = c.id AND a.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND a.del_flag = 0 WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.application_id = #{appId} AND c.del_flag = 0
AND (c.capability_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.capability_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY c.update_time DESC, c.id DESC

SELECT c.id AS capability_id, c.capability_code, c.source_type, c.source_key, v.policy_snapshot FROM ai_capability c INNER JOIN ai_capability_version v ON v.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND v.capability_id = c.id AND v.version = c.current_version AND v.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND v.del_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN ai_application_capability a ON a.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND a.application_id = #{appId} AND a.capability_id = c.id AND a.del_flag = 0 WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND c.publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' AND c.enabled = 1 AND c.del_flag = 0 AND a.id IS NULL AND c.source_type IN ('BUSINESS_ACTION', 'FLOW_ACTION', 'SYSTEM_SERVICE') ORDER BY c.id

SELECT c.id AS capability_id, c.capability_code, c.source_type, c.source_key, v.policy_snapshot FROM ai_application_capability a INNER JOIN ai_capability c ON c.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND c.id = a.capability_id AND c.publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' AND c.enabled = 1 AND c.del_flag = 0 INNER JOIN ai_capability_version v ON v.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND v.capability_id = c.id AND v.version = c.current_version AND v.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND v.del_flag = 0 WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.application_id = #{appId} AND a.del_flag = 0 ORDER BY c.id

SELECT c.id AS capability_id, c.capability_code, c.source_type, c.source_key, v.policy_snapshot FROM ai_application_capability a INNER JOIN ai_capability c ON c.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND c.id = a.capability_id AND c.publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' AND c.enabled = 1 AND c.del_flag = 0 INNER JOIN ai_capability_version v ON v.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND v.capability_id = c.id AND v.version = c.current_version AND v.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND v.del_flag = 0 WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.application_id = #{appId} AND a.del_flag = 0 AND c.source_type = #{sourceType} AND c.source_key = #{sourceKey} ORDER BY c.id
